timing.limitation: Validation read the revision-17 ticket, advisory findings, and existing frozen fixture interfaces but did not inspect or execute patched product outcomes before this freeze.

data_provenance.source: Synthetic deep copies of frozen conformance fixtures plus local subprocess observations of exact frozen commands.
data_provenance.consent: Not applicable; no personal or external data
data_provenance.split: Four adverse fixtures and four positive controls
data_provenance.transformations: Deterministic field deletion, target omission, provenance mutation, and exact command-output parsing
data_provenance.digest: Bound by protocol lock and harness digest
data_provenance.leakage_controls: No patched outcome observation before freeze; no held-out tuning or post-result threshold changes

measurement.baseline: The revision-16 advisory review reproduced all four High findings.
measurement.metric: Exact deterministic unittest and subprocess agreement
measurement.uncertainty_method: None; deterministic fixtures and exact counts

thresholds.new_suite: 8/8 pass with zero failures, errors, or skips
thresholds.raw_prior: 111 run: 108 pass and exactly the three declared superseded failures; zero other failures, errors, or skips
thresholds.corrected_preclosure: 124/124 pass with zero failures, errors, or skips
thresholds.corrected_closure_aggregate: 132/132 pass with zero failures, errors, or skips
thresholds.final_content_stable_release: The report digest is identical before and after check-release; check-release exits 0 with errors=[] and release_integrity=pass

criteria.claim: Release evidence is derived from exact independently runnable counts and is rerun only after report content is stable.
criteria.adverse_case: Any fourth raw failure, nonzero raw error/skip, corrected count below 124, or report mutation across check-release rejects.
criteria.positive_case: Raw 111 is exactly 108 plus three declared superseded failures, corrected preclosure is 124/124, and a content-stable check-release passes.

criteria.claim: Only monotonic review bookkeeping with unchanged invalidation, product/provenance bytes, and intact Validation lineage may follow Validation integration.
criteria.adverse_case: A post-Validation state with behavior-affecting provenance drift rejects release.
criteria.positive_case: The unchanged canonical post-Validation review-only lineage passes release integrity.

criteria.claim: E1 and E2 completion require every manual embodied-safety control and current referenced evidence.
criteria.adverse_case: For E1 and E2, deleting any heartbeat, telemetry, command-rate, hazard, dry-run, stop-condition, incident-recovery, or deterministic-validation control rejects.
criteria.positive_case: Complete E1 and E2 structured controls with current evidence pass contract validation without granting physical authorization.

criteria.claim: Formal review targets every current artifact ID declared by the exact Reviewer ticket inputs.
criteria.adverse_case: A formal Reviewer ticket declares two current artifacts but targets only one; validation rejects.
criteria.positive_case: The same exact ticket targets both declared current artifacts and passes.

robustness_cases: Unexpected raw failure and stale corrected aggregate
E1 and E2 with each newly mandatory safety field removed
One omitted versus all declared formal-review artifact targets
safety_cases: No physical or external action is executed
E1/E2 completion remains contract evidence only
Formal review coverage is exact and nonempty
